 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Choose the marker color whose count increases most below the divider."""
    divider = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("No horizontal 5 divider found")
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    if not colors:
        raise ValueError("No marker colors found")
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    def rank(color):
        above = sum(cell == color for row in upper for cell in row)
        below = sum(cell == color for row in lower for cell in row)
        return (below - above, below, above, color)
    chosen = max(colors, key=rank)
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
